posts.name: Agnivesh Jyotiraditya Kannankara
posts.cooked:
Sorry to repeat this question sir, but I was under the impression we were only allowed to use the course vm during the oppe
So if I’m understanding correctly, we’re allowed to have a separate tab which hasn’t logged into the course vm to run commands on our local system then?

posts.name: Sayan Ghosh
posts.cooked:
1. You are not allowed access to course VM during OPPE, you can only access OPPE VM (where NPPE is conducted).
  2. You should only log into OPPE VM and use that for running and testing out commands and man pages. You can use tmux to multiplex your session and open different tabs and panes side by side. This also saves your session in case of a disconnect.

posts.name: Sayan Ghosh
posts.cooked:
Please use tmux for multiplexing. You can open as many tabs/panes as you like. You do not need to ssh into vm in each one, rather ssh once and then open a tmux session. It will also help you restore your session if you lose the connection.

Refer this.
